title: BetterLimay Service Referral
description: Answers 'I need X and Limay does not do it'. A referral points a resident at the entity that does provide the service — the province, a water district, a national agency — without importing that entity's services into the municipal catalog, where a reader could mistake its fees for the Municipality's.

office.description: The office within that entity, as its charter names it.

entity.description: The juridical entity accountable for the service.

entityScope.description: Never 'municipal': a municipal service belongs in services.json, not here.

serviceCount.description: How many services this office lists, for the fuller index.

examples.description: A few service names verbatim, so a reader can recognise their need.
